## Answer sheet (open only after answering)

### 1. `CIVIO-GF2K04-CLR-FILE-BUSINESS-0001`: key (B) Goldfield Hardware

- Why correct: "Goldfield Hardware" is filed last. In filing order the indexed units are: GOLD / COAST / TRAVEL; GOLDEN / HARVEST / RICE / MILL; GOLDEN / WOK / RESTAURANT / THE; GOLDFIELD / HARDWARE. Read & as "and" and treat a leading "The" as the last unit (ARMA Rule 2). This follows the standard office filing rule (ARMA International Simplified Filing Standard Rules, Rule 2), not a rule published by the CSC. Source standard: ANSI/ARMA 12-2005.
- (A) "The Golden Wok Restaurant" is the answer only if you filed the name under its leading "The". Indexed correctly it is GOLDEN / WOK / RESTAURANT / THE, which files third.
- (C) "Golden Harvest Rice Mill" indexes as GOLDEN / HARVEST / RICE / MILL and files second, not last.
- (D) "Gold Coast Travel" indexes as GOLD / COAST / TRAVEL and files first, not last.
- Source: Civio Filing Rules v2 / ARMA Rule 2 (ANSI/ARMA 12-2005) <https://webstore.ansi.org/standards/arma/ansiarma122005>
- File: `docs/research/gap-fill-2000-04.json`
